instrument.walk: f(x) = mix64(x XOR K_walk) mod N (N a power of two: low bits)
instrument.dp: mix64(x XOR K_dp) < floor(2^64/W), K_dp independent of K_walk
instrument.primary_mixer: murmur3 fmix64 (deliberately NOT the splitmix64 example of the contract)
instrument.keys: sha256("validator-7ec3ea|<mixer>|<walk|dp>|N<N>|<i>")[:8]; 8 keys primary, 5 keys sensitivity, per cell
instrument.basin_rule: DP d belongs to its own basin at distance 0; x in basin(d) iff first DP on forward orbit is d at distance <= cap; points never reaching a DP (DP-free cycle points and tails feeding them) and points with first DP beyond the cap are excluded and reported
instrument.fixture_rule: pool: uniform-start walks capped at 8W until 2T DISTINCT DPs, every walk charged to P (capped walks at the cap), each walk (length,+1) credited to its DP, a start that is itself a DP terminates at length 0; weight S_d + 4 W h_d; top-T with ties by seeded permutation; M=40000 uniform-start single-walk trials, cap 8W; scaled cost = total trial steps / hits / sqrt(N/T); scaled P = P/sqrt(NT)
